notes.title: HUGE ART REVAMP, CONTROLLER SUPPORT, & STEAM ACHIEVEMENTS UPDATE
notes.content:
[p]Hi Everyone! Sorry it's been a while since we last updated the game but we have been working on the game for quite a while and here are the changes that we did : 
[/p][list][*][p]REVAMPED Art with consistent pixel sizes for every building that is in the game![/p][/*][*][p]Added a Parallax background that moves with the player instead of a static background[/p][/*][*][p]Added CONTROLLER SUPPORT for every movements of the player![/p][/*][*][p]Added STEAM ACHIEVEMENTS so you can 100% the game properly![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Overall, this has been quite a visual update and more of a quality of life update but we hope you keep enjoying \[K]night City and keep a look out for potential contents in the future!

Thank you so much![/p]

tags.feature: REVAMPED Art with consistent pixel sizes for every building that is in the game!
Added a Parallax background that moves with the player instead of a static background
Added CONTROLLER SUPPORT for every movements of the player!
Added STEAM ACHIEVEMENTS so you can 100% the game properly!
